name: Ski Center Latemar
note: Obereggen, Pampeago and Predazzo, three villages linked around the Latemar.
basesWhy: The three villages, plus the lift names OSM tends to use where it does not name the station after the village. Obereggen and Pampeago are the two big car parks; Predazzo is the third way in, up the Gardone gondola.
operationsProvenance: PLACEHOLDER. lastUp and queue are not from OpenStreetMap and are not yet from the resort either. They must be replaced with published lift hours before this resort is marked available.
defaultBaseWhy: The largest of the three bases and the one most people drive to.
toleranceWhy: Measured across the first real export. 60 keeps 19 lifts, 207 runs and 72.8 km with all four bases working and three of them serving a blue skier. 45 finds no more lifts and splits the mountain into thirty more nodes; 90 costs two lifts, seven kilometres and Stalimen's blue day.
publishedSource: Ski Center Latemar's own published network figures. Recorded from general knowledge rather than fetched, because no site is reachable from this machine; npm run resort:verify will hold the graph against them and say plainly where they disagree.
bboxWhy: Covers all three villages and the Latemar ridge between them: Obereggen at 11.47/46.37, Pampeago at 11.51/46.34 and Predazzo at 11.60/46.31, with a margin so no piste runs off an edge.
